Interium bundles an unmodified ViaFabricPlus 4.4.15 jar by the ViaFabricPlus contributors, under GPL version 3. Its license and dependency notices are contained within the bundled jar. Original repository: https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus .
Source corresponding to this binary (commit e18a48113ea2e8c44b6fd5d725cda06a7ef94864, taken from the binary's vfp:implVersion): https://github.com/ViaVersion/ViaFabricPlus/tree/e18a48113ea2e8c44b6fd5d725cda06a7ef94864 .
No claim is made that this development bundle has been runtime-tested.
